facts.event: 北方四国（Gevera、Hallion、Falcan、Widdin）的败亡者结队南下，被接应到 Ardwen 海岸安置，再被东送往 Kanaan。
facts.anchor: Finally, we had gathered a force worth mustering from those fallen in the north: Gevera, Hallion, Falcan and Widdin.

facts.event: 侍女 Marolyn 被吵醒后抱怨，叫叙事者全名 Tuathilde 并让她回去睡。
facts.relation: Marolyn 是 Tilde 的侍女（maid），十五岁，比 Tilde 大一岁
facts.anchor: She was fifteen, and a year my senior, which meant she still felt the right to use my full name when annoyed.

facts.event: 叙事者的兄姐 Colfinn 与 Ebba 已在与 Cynghals 的小规模交战中赢得名声，此刻仍在帐中酣睡。
facts.relation: Colfinn 与 Ebba 是 Tilde 的兄姐；Hadiah 是她的表亲
facts.anchor: Colfinn the bright, Ebba the brave, they had already earned their names in skirmishes with the Cynghals.

facts.event: 身穿 Gevera 颜色、却排成 Cynghal 阵形的士兵在月下冲进熟睡的部族营地。
facts.anchor: under the silver-sickle moon I could see men in Geveran colours but Cynghal formation.

facts.event: Tilde 抓起刀跑出帐篷去找 Sanafin；此前两人只在 kingsmoot 前见过两次。
facts.relation: Sanafin 是 Kanaan 的继承人（heir）
facts.anchor: Sanafin was the heir of Kanaan. We had met only twice before the kingsmoot

facts.event: Sanafin 告诉 Tilde：Geverans 把 Cynghals 藏在队伍里、听其号令，Ardweni 必须退进森林。
facts.anchor: The Geverans hid Cynghals amongst them, and obey their every squawk.

facts.event: 一支箭射穿 Sanafin 的喉咙，Marolyn 把 Tilde 扑倒在地。
facts.anchor: An arrow had taken her through the throat. Her blood mingled with her red hair

facts.event: Sanafin 死去，黑山楂与荆棘从地面爆开、覆住她的身体并把她拖入土中。
facts.anchor: the thorns covering her over like the shield of a warrior, and took her from me into the earth
